description: Choice shown in a card, with single or multiple selection and explanatory content.

howToUse: Use it for choices that need more than a label to decide: plans with price, delivery options with deadline, templates with a preview.
Put the cards inside ChoiceCardGroup and give the group a `label` with the question.
Use `mode="single"` when only one can be chosen, and `mode="multiple"` when several can.
Set `columns` by how many fit side by side; `columns={1}` stacks them on mobile.
alternatives: Short options that a label explains: RadioGroup or Checkbox.

keyboard.action: Enters the group and leaves it on the next Tab.
Moves between the cards. With `mode="single"`, also selects.
Goes to the first or last card.
Selects the card in focus, or clears it with `mode="multiple"`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Small inline icon before the title (slot).

props.name: preview
props.description: Large preview above the text (slot, e.g. theme sample).

props.name: meta
props.description: Meta/price (mono) below or to the right of the text.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label of the group (required without a visible external label).

examples.label: Theme choice (single)
Credit packs (with meta/price)
examples.code:
import { ChoiceCard } from '@refy-design/web';
import { ChoiceCardGroup } from '@refy-design/web';
export function Example() {
  return (
    <ChoiceCardGroup label="Credit pack" defaultValue="200">
      <ChoiceCard
        value="100"
        title="100 credits"
        description="Occasional use."
        meta="R$ 90 · R$ 0.90/credit"
      />
      <ChoiceCard
        value="200"
        title="200 credits"
        description="Best value."
        meta="R$ 160 · R$ 0.80/credit"
      />
      <ChoiceCard
        value="500"
        title="500 credits"
        description="Heavy use."
        meta="R$ 350 · R$ 0.70/credit"
      />
    </ChoiceCardGroup>
  );
}
